run_orbslam2_rgbd_agent: run the ORBSLAM2Agent with RGBD sensors for visual SLAM navigation in Habitat simulator environments
run_orbslam2_monodepth_agent: run the ORBSLAM2MonodepthAgent that uses monocular depth estimation instead of depth sensors for navigation
run_blind_agent: run the BlindAgent that navigates toward a goal using only GPS compass and angle information without visual input
run_random_agent: run the RandomAgent that takes random actions until the goal distance threshold is reached
run_slam_agent_benchmark: run a benchmark evaluation of SLAM-based agents using argparse to select agent type and task config file
